title: Localized reinitialization of MgF2/HfO2 chirped stack with frozen front section
scientific_hypothesis: Freezing layers 1-9 at iteration_06 optimal values while applying ±3 nm perturbation bounds to layers 10-20 will reduce residual ripple artifacts in the 400-700 nm sub-band without degrading passband transmission, as the thinner rear layers dominate phase accumulation errors in the visible stopband.
design_principle: Localized optimization with asymmetric bounds: coarse stopband shaping locked in front section, fine phase correction in rear section where non-quarter-wave deviations cause visible-band ripple.
proposed_topology: exactly 20 finite layers from the incident side: HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2
manufacturing_considerations: Sub-100 nm layers require precise thickness control
Ion-assisted deposition recommended for HfO2 density and moisture stability
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for coherent multilayer interference
Phase accumulation sensitivity scales with optical thickness; thinner layers exhibit higher relative phase error for fixed absolute thickness tolerance
expected_advantages: Reduced optimization search space improves convergence
Frozen front section preserves established stopband edge shaping
Tight bounds on rear layers target ripple sources identified in iteration_06 spectra
known_risks: Over-constraining may prevent global optimum discovery
Fixed front layers may lock in suboptimal phase relationships
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 20-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2 / HfO2 / MgF2. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 20-layer MgF2/HfO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layers 1-9 fixed at thicknesses: [144.99, 130.26, 125.53, 124.68, 126.05, 121.32, 116.58, 111.84, 97.11] nm. Layers 10-20 initialized at [95.67, 87.63, 84.42, 88.16, 83.42, 78.68, 63.95, 69.21, 54.47, 49.74, 55.00] nm with optimization bounds ±3 nm around these seeds. Material sequence: MgF2(layer1), HfO2(layer2), alternating. Optimize for maximum mean transmittance 255-280 nm, minimum mean transmittance 300-700 nm, minimum mean transmittance 700-1100 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with coherent TMM solver. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 255–280 nm; low transmittance in 300–700 nm; low transmittance in 700–1100 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 300–700 nm; transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30; no metal layers; conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: localized reinitialization with ±3 nm bounds on layers 10-20, layers 1-9 frozen at iteration_06 optimal values to target visible-band ripple artifacts.
